sections.content:
For legal, official, or important correspondence in Hungary, you use specific registered mail options:
- **Ajánlott levél** = Registered letter (tracked with a tracking barcode)
- **Tértivevény (tértivevényes levél)** = Return receipt requested (the recipient must sign a pink slip on delivery, which is mailed back to the sender as legal proof of receipt)
- **Feladóvevény** = Dispatch receipt / certificate of posting stamped by the clerk
- *Feladó* = Sender (top left of the envelope)
- *Címzett* = Recipient / Addressee (bottom right of the envelope).

items.spanish: Ajánlottan és tértivevénnyel szeretném feladni a hivatalos dokumentumot.
items.english: I would like to send the official document registered with return receipt.

items.spanish: Kérem, töltse ki ezt a feladóvevényt a feladó és a címzett adataival!
items.english: Please fill out this dispatch receipt with the sender and recipient details!

items.spanish: Őrizze meg a feladóvevényt a küldemény azonosítójával!
items.english: Keep the dispatch receipt with the tracking number of the item!
